ServiceNow Assistant — four directions

Same brand: Segoe UI, black bar with the yellow rule, cream ground, 12px radii, existing badge tones. Pick one and I'll build it.

All four fix the table overflow the same way: fixed layout, category under the description, dates split over two lines.

A · Refined chat — smallest change. Keeps the layout you have; adds a result card around the data, one segmented Keyword/Claude control, and a table that never scrolls sideways. Tradeoff: data still scrolls away in a long conversation.

B · Split view — talk on the left, data pinned on the right with tabs. Nothing gets buried; the sidebar collapses to a rail to pay for the width. Tradeoff: the conversation column gets narrow, and it needs a mobile fallback.

C · Dashboard first — the priority breakdown is always on screen, the assistant is a docked panel that filters it. Best for 'how many by priority'. Tradeoff: biggest build, and it leads with numbers rather than conversation.
D · Command palette — dark, keyboard-driven, results as full-width cards so there is no table to overflow at all. Tradeoff: least familiar, and long records need a detail view to open into.
